meta.name: refactor-with-guardrails
meta.description: Run refactors in behavior-preserving, small-step mode with characterization tests and checkpoints. Use when improving structure without intentional behavior changes.

copy.tagline: 用特征测试和安全检查点逐步重构代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在保持行为不变的前提下改善代码结构
copy.tagline_en: Refactor code step by step with characterization tests and safe checkpoints
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to improve code structure without changing behavior

howto.what: Claude 会先读取协议和技能使用规则，收集仓库证据，然后生成带基线测试、步骤检查点和无行为变更声明的重构序列，最后验证测试通过才结束。
howto.when: 当你要求重构代码以改善结构，且不改变原有行为时触发。

say.text: 帮我重构这个函数，保持行为不变。
say.note: Claude 会生成带测试的重构步骤。

say.text: 对模块A做安全重构，添加检查点。
say.note: Claude 会逐步重构并验证每个步骤。

howto.what_en: Claude reads protocol and skill policy, collects repo evidence, then produces a refactor sequence with baseline tests, step checkpoints, and a no-behavior-change declaration, verifying tests pass before closing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to refactor code to improve structure without changing behavior.

say_en.text: Refactor this function while preserving behavior.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a refactor sequence with tests.

say_en.text: Safely refactor module A with checkpoints.
say_en.note: Claude will refactor step by step and verify each step.
